label: bench-02-holmes-native-missing-secret-key
diagnosis:
### Observations
1. Pod `notifications-worker-6784d8b8df-lk5l8` logs error `ERROR notifications-worker: missing required setting SMTP_PASSWORD (environment variable is unset or empty)`. (Source: pod log)
2. Deployment `notifications-worker` maps `SMTP_PASSWORD` via optional `secretKeyRef` to key `SMTP_PASSWORD` in secret `notifications-smtp`. (Source: deployment `notifications-worker` `.spec.template.spec.containers[0].env`)
3. Secret `notifications-smtp` holds key name `smtp-password` following its scheduled rotation. (Source: deployment log CI-2398)

### Ruled-out leads
1. Out-of-memory termination was ruled out because container status terminated with exit code 1, not exit code 137 / OOMKilled. (Source: pod status `.status.containerStatuses[0].lastState.terminated`)
2. Missing secret reference blocking container creation was ruled out because `optional: true` allows startup without raising `CreateContainerConfigError`. (Source: runbook RB-026)

### Root cause
Deployment `notifications-worker` v2.0.0 references key `SMTP_PASSWORD` instead of the secret's actual key `smtp-password`, leaving the variable unset. (Source: deployment log CI-2459)

### Recommended action
The notifications team should update deployment `notifications-worker` `secretKeyRef.key` to `smtp-password`. (Source: runbook RB-026)
